name: Chain-cutter imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, hacking with a little notched cleaver in one claw, its tongue out in concentration

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, the notched cleaver raised in one claw, tongue out
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hacks the notched cleaver down hard in front of it to the right, again and again, sparks flying

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
